# Getting Started

This is sample course content for local development and smoke testing.

- `01 - Welcome.mp4` — short synthetic H.264/AAC playback test video (SMPTE color bars + tone).
- `01 - Welcome.en.srt` — sample English subtitle sidecar.
- `slides.pdf` — short Go introduction and runnable example.
- `examples/hello/` — self-contained Go module with source files and a table-driven test.
